title: Markwayne Mullin defends move to take government plane to football game amid flight stoppage – US politics live
description:
The secretary of homeland security flew to attend a college game Saturday, after thousands of flights were cancelled

Linked to that, the White House held a briefing call with several reporters today about the wave of tech outages affecting several industries. CNN reported that officials said the administration underscored that what has happened is not as a result of cyber-attacks but due to the “hardening and upgrading of our systems”, including “systems being patched, hardware being applied”.

Per CNN, an official added: “It’s good the American people are focused on the need to upgrade our legacy systems.”
